dedicated_space.basis: the space over electrical gear (its width and depth, from the floor to 6 ft above it or the structural ceiling, whichever is lower) is dedicated to it, and piping, ducts and equipment foreign to it may not run there; a suspended ceiling is no structural ceiling (110.26(E)(1)(d)); a pipe or duct the documents run through it is offset past the gear's side by the clearance, as the field installs it
dedicated_space.exempt_basis: NEC 110.26(E)(1)(c): sprinkler protection of the dedicated space is permitted
